title: Akiyama Mizuki — Cuteness For You〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... The lake should be...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was gonna check to see how the tree's doing...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But this place really has a way of messing with your sense of direction...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, MEIKO!
Any chance you're heading over to the lake?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Perfect!
That's also where I'm headed, so wanna go together?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Follow me if you like. It's your choice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, not much has changed since then?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Correct. At the very least, not while I've been looking at it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thanks for keeping an eye on it, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh... Miku's singing over by the tree.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But I think she's asleep...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: W-Wait, what if she's having a weird dream again?! We gotta go see what's up, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Is everything okay?
The tree isn't doing anything weird again, is it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No...
Mafuyu just asked me to sing for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here I was worried that those black fragments were back... What a relief!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Still...
On top of that weird dream, her life has been pretty hectic lately.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's no wonder she's feeling fatigued.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm glad that she isn't in pain or anything right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When those black fragments showed her that dream, Mafuyu seemed to be suffering...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, this SEKAI is one of the few places where she can really feel at ease.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes...
Another is when she's with you and the others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree...
It's likely why she spent so much time looking for all of you in the dream.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
S-Sorry, I didn't mean to clam up there!
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think I understand what Mafuyu was feeling then, is all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, sorry.
Did I wake you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it wasn't your voice that woke me up...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to head back soon...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, already?
But you just woke up. Shouldn't you take it easy?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I still have some homework left to do.
I need to finish it by 25:00...
